title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - PowerLimitProfile
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/PowerLimitProfile. This profile describes the energy flexibility of a device via a set of power limits, following the SPINE documentation Subclass of FlexibilityProfile per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityProfile model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PowerLimitProfile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isBoundTo.description: Relationship. The relationship between a device and its contractual power limit Relationship to ContractualPowerLimit.

isLimitedWith.description: Relationship. The relationship between device and failsafe power limit Relationship to FailsafePowerLimit.

isProtectedBy.description: Relationship. The relationship between the device and the nominal power limit Relationship to NominalPowerLimit.

receivesPowerLimit.description: Relationship. The relationship between a power limit profile and the power limit it has received for its device to follow Relationship to PowerLimit.
